reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:105d3eb2d58fd6d58a627169f5228948]] This product works so well! I love that there are different settings for the different speeds/pressures. It does the job well and doesn't take up a lot of space, which I am really happy about. It also comes with different types of nozzles which were fun to play with and see how each one affects the gums/teeth. If you want to step up your oral hygiene, this water flosser is a key tool to getting you there!

This is May the second Flosser brush. I bought the first as a gift to my husband, he was very pleased. I decided what I need to buy with nozzles and I found one. Good electric coldress oral irrigator flosser for a low price. The kit includes the device itself, charging and 5 interchangeable tips. Auto shut off after 2 minutes. It cleans well between the teeth. Braces and dentures.In addition, Water Flosser strengthens the gums in the interdental space, as my dentist said, I have less trauma in m

This is my first time using a water flosser. I’ve heard they are painful, but this one is not, it feels like a massage on my gums. It seems to work very well, even getting things stuck in between my teeth to come out. It’s nice that it rinses as it cleans. The different heads that it comes with accommodate a wide variety of sensitivities and preferences of water stream strength. The fact that it is cordless is really nice too.

This does the job. It is light, easy to handle, and works at all angles. I'm never sure why items that are manufactured in other countries don't take 5 minutes to consult one English speaking person before they print their directions but easy enough to figure out. The second to lowest setting is enough for me. Always wait until it's in your mouth to turn it on and then be over the sink.

reviews.t: Not worth it. Only lasted a week.
reviews.x: Had ordered this about a week ago and mines just stopped working. First I was going to send it back because it had no plug, but decided to try it. Now I'm returning it. I purchased 2 I'm hoping my Granddaughter doesnt have issues with hers. Right now I'm returning the one I have Such a waste.

Great concept. Poor quality. First day of having it, water leaked all over my counter like there is a crack somewhere. Bummed. Would have liked to give it a better rating since it has lots of good attachments, easy to use, and charging was fast.
Pressure is great and does not leak!! I have to refill it about 5 times during one use but this has a big tank compared to other cordless water flossers.
IT WORKS WELL BUT THERE IS ALWAYS A PUDDLE OF WATER AT THE BOTTOM OF THE FLOSSER. VERY,VERY ANNOYING.
It worked well for first 2 months then stopped pulling water through.
Makes such a mess literally don’t know how someone could use this
After using it for 4 months, it quit working.

reviews.t: Useful for travel oversea, great customer service
reviews.x: Work as described. Bought mainly because of the USB port. With the proper power adapter, it can be used for international travel. The strength of water stream is not as strong as the Waterpik regular AC power product. The stabilizer in the water tank drains the water but make noticeable noise.  Re-edited: 10/14/2020 After around 10 months of usage, twice a day, the battery stopped charging. I contacted the seller to claim their one year warranty. In just three days, I have received a new replace

reviews.t: Hate flossing? Here is your fix!
reviews.x: I love this thing.  I've hated flossing for as long as I've been brushing my teeth. This thing works amazing and I like using it. I put half mouth wash and half warm water because my teeth are sensitive and it's heaven. Make sure it's in your mouth before you turn it on! I've sprayed my ceiling and the wall a couple of times.. oops. Also the highest setting when fully charged can cut your gums it's so powerful! Start on the lowest and go up as you feel comfortable for you.

I needed a replacement flosser, and this is 10xs better than my previous one. It’s sturdy, comfortable when holding (not too heavy), and it holds enough water for 1 full usage. I received it 3 weeks ago and I’ve only charged it once.  I have braces and it’s the only flosser I’ll use now. The orthodontic tip is amazing. Not too much pressure but it cleans in between & under my wires and around my brackets.

The first one came with toothpaste residue and water already in the water reservoir. But they easily accepted a return and send a new one out. It works well extremely powerful, be careful and start on the low setting. Only issue is the water reservoir doesn't detach, there is a small hole to fill it up and to leave open to dry. This makes it more susceptible to mold if you don't maintain it.

reviews.t: Great find on a powerful cordless flosser.  Charging capability is awesome!
reviews.x: I've had this for quite a few months now and have had to charge it once.  A single charge lasts a long time.  I love the pulse rate and powerful water jets. It has a wide variety of variables so you can go light or harder. My husband has another name brand and he has to keep his pretty much plugged into the charger all the time and it has no where the power of this one.  Great buy!

The cordless water flosser comes with great selection flossing tips and multiple water pressure settings. My flosser was charged and ready for use in 3 hours. It has performed perfectly and it is very comfortable in my hand while using. I read several reviews on many flossers, and decided to purchase this one. After using it several times now I can say I made the right choice!

reviews.t: Doesn't work as well after a year.
reviews.x: I've had it around a year. It was good for a while, but now it doesn't hold a charge and sometimes won't work. Have to keep it fully charged to work, but even then the pressure of the water has gone down significantly. Will need to get another, so even though it doesn't cost that much, I didn't think I would need to replace it in a year.

reviews.t: Wish it lasted longer and no customer service
reviews.x: Bought my water flosser in August 2020 and it simply stopped working.  The item is supposed to have a one year warranty but all attempts to reach customer service have gone unanswered.  When the product worked, it worked great but it should have lasted more than ten months.  Guess we can chalk it up to another casualty of 2020?

reviews.t: Like the size and gravity ball
reviews.x: Very convenient. I have one got from Costco years ago, which just requires too much work for a single use. It ended up sitting inside the cabinet for three years. This one is small and easy to operate. I like the gravity ball inside the water tank. A small but genius design! So you can hold it in whatever direction you like

My husband loves this water floss. After a week using, he gives it a great feedback. It is easy to use and the gravity ball allows him to clean every corner in the mouth without no water. Due to the COVID, he can’t see dentist regularly. This water flosser helps cleans the dirts and keeps his teeth healthy. Recommended!

For the first couple of weeks, I used this once a day and it worked great. Suddenly, it simply stopped releasing pressurized water; the water would just dribble out.  I tried changing the head, but to no avail.  I returned it after two weeks of use; it seems like it's a cheaply made product.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it cleans well between teeth and gums, even reaching wisdom teeth and stuck food.
Several reviewers report leaks or water pooling, and some units stopped working within weeks to months.
Reviewers praise the multiple pressure settings and included interchangeable nozzles.
Some find it easy to handle and good value for the price, though a few note it is messy or noisy.
